description: This component is based on the [Radix UI Tooltip](https://www.radix-ui.com/primitives/docs/components/tooltip) primitive.

content.description: The content to display in the tooltip.

onClick.description: A function that is triggered when the tooltip is clicked.

side.description:
The side to position the tooltip.

@defaultValue top

maxWidth.description: The maximum width of the tooltip.

sideOffset.description:
The distance in pixels between the tooltip and its trigger.

@keep

children.description:
The element to trigger the tooltip.

@keep

open.description:
Whether the tooltip is currently open.

@keep

defaultOpen.description:
Whether the tooltip is open by default.

@keep

onOpenChange.description:
A function that is called when the tooltip's open state changes.

@keep

delayDuration.description:
The time in milliseconds to delay the tooltip's appearance.

@keep
